slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies to build a life so good
you stop doomscrolling

a windowsill garden

grow herbs or a small plant on your windowsill and look after it every morning. watching something grow because of you is slower than a feed, and much better for you.

film photography

buy a cheap film camera and take one photo a day. with only 24 shots and no screen, you start looking at the world properly instead of through your phone.

a weekly dinner club

invite the same two or three friends over once a week and take turns cooking. having something real to look forward to makes the endless scroll feel empty very fast.

learning something new

swap your first 5 minutes of scrolling every morning for 5 minutes of learning: a planet, a myth, an artist. the day starts with something that stays instead of something you forget.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning something new

i used to scroll first thing every morning. now i open the Sophia app instead and spend 5 minutes on one lesson: a planet, a myth, an artist. my days start so much better.

slides.texte_overlay:
walks without your phone

once a week, go on a long walk and leave your phone at home. the first ten minutes feel strange, and after that you remember what your own thoughts sound like.
